A '''Bronze Trophy Frog Sack''' is an {{Uncommon}} [[Sack]] that holds {{Green|512}} of each {{DarkGray|Bronze}} [[Trophy Frog]]. 

== Obtaining ==
A '''Bronze Trophy Frog Sack''' can be obtained as a reward for reaching [[Researcher Ribery#Novice Frog Collector|Novice Frog Collector]]. If lost, it can be bought from from {{NPCSprite|Researcher Ribery}} for {{c|50k}} after reaching the milestone.

== Usage ==
The '''Bronze Trophy Frog Sack''' can store {{DarkGray|Bronze}} [[Trophy Frog]]s.
